scope: Original Todoist P0 plus productive widgets for the two independently owned Apple apps. Existing evidence audit reconciled with subsequent native widget acceptance; historical result bundles below are retained, not newly executed.

requirements.requirement: Current API pagination/mapping, useful preview/auth errors, duplicate-free import/retry and unchanged Todoist source.
requirements.boundary: Mac first-import response loss was not separately injected; phone first-import and Mac replay retry are the accepted bounded coverage.

requirements.requirement: Useful capture with supported reference/date/deadline/estimate/repeat/reminder grammar, explicit invalid feedback and durable edits.
requirements.boundary: Full Todoist natural-language equivalence is not claimed; remaining spoken coverage is separate.

requirements.requirement: Stable account-owned filters/favorites/view settings; original documented Boolean/date/target subset, offline persistence, safe ordering and access boundaries.
requirements.boundary: All-four-table SQL evidence, shared owned ORDER implementation and representative native conflict/handoffs cover the bounded contract. Per-list native permutations remain unexercised, not universally accepted.

requirements.requirement: Independent deadline/estimate, rescheduling/Undo, recurrence boundaries, old-cache/backup compatibility and honest hourly/calendar capacity.
requirements.boundary: Read-only EventKit is implemented; external mirroring and richer recurrence grammar retain their original later-phase scope.

requirements.requirement: Local scheduling, actual closed-app actions/snooze, cancellation and account/stale-callback safety.
requirements.boundary: Simulator/local alerts do not prove APNs or signed distribution.

requirements.requirement: Validated portable/encrypted restore, relationships, safe Cancel/retry, account-owned reads and actual external-provider boundaries.
requirements.boundary: Representative native recovery and external-file cases pass in recorded scope, including actual iPhone provider download/restore/relaunch, same-file unavailable/retry and late provider response after system-picker cancellation plus local workspace departure/return. No new authenticated external-provider matrix, app-received late URL callback or universal provider compatibility claim.

requirements.requirement: Relevant work survives device switches, offline queues/review, generation/identity guards and access revocation.
requirements.boundary: Old active writers must be upgraded/retired; service still allows legacy direct writes. Nested/attachment collision evidence is core/transport, not a claimed universal native matrix.

requirements.requirement: Twelve productive kinds, stable per-instance configuration, useful routes/actions, durable completion, privacy/account isolation and readable installed hosts.
requirements.boundary: Named representative installed Mac routes/layouts now include Day capacity and Inbox reset alongside recorded Today/My list/note/Focus/Pulse journeys. Day capacity has human medium-card readability; corrected isolated Inbox has exact native cold-review/count evidence, not a separately confirmed replacement layout. Named local/two-account cycle remains bounded; second-account AX click is not accepted. Actual host-selected system privacy remains open. No every-combination claim or gate.

requirements.requirement: Native capture/edit/plan/complete/Undo/recovery, accessible controls and explicit assessment of actual runtime findings.
requirements.boundary: Named representative Mac spoken scope remains accepted. Genuine iOS 27 task capture, Save, edit, completed-task-name announcement, persistent Undo, restored task speech and exact whole-cache relaunch now pass; original fixture records remain exact. Minutes/estimate and invalid-filter warnings are genuinely spoken. Native Restore control and actual file-picker output are read. Human Cancel reaches the accepted UIKit callback and restores a usable host. Actual Settings Back button return fails the recovery-specific speech expectation; same-case cache equality/relaunch assertions were not reached. Automated inputs previously failed to cancel. No app guard defect, all-gesture or clean-runtime claim. Current iOS source now requests Restore focus after sheet dismissal; native Cancel/retry and whole-cache relaunch pass with VoiceOver off. Current-build spoken return remains unverified; see ios-restore-focus-evidence.json. Subsequent human test rejected the first focus repair but proved whole-cache equality after Cancel. Current source repairs the traced dismissal-before-callback race; two focus requests reach the Restore binding in the native regression. Spoken verification remains open; see ios-restore-focus-order-evidence.json.

requirements.requirement: Independent app/release sources, compatible candidate pair, real provider/device delivery and signed distribution before rollout.
requirements.boundary: Enrolled signing/capabilities, final provider/device/APNs acceptance, notarized/signed install and old-writer rollout remain. Remote delivery stays disabled; recognized email is optional future provider work, not active delivery.

verificationBoundary: Ten existing native cases in eight bundles reverified, not ten new executions or proof of every feature. Historical failed/warning-bearing results and artifact limitations remain intact.
remainingPrerequisites: Actual supported system privacy controls/locked transition.

Genuine iOS VoiceOver returned focus and same-case relaunch on the newer callback-order repair. Human native Cancel and whole-cache equality already pass; first focus repair reproduced Settings Back button. Native event/binding delivery is verified on current source with VoiceOver off.
stoppingRule: Do not invent a gate for every possible combination or substitute easier previews/core tests. Continue distinct actionable risks; resume prerequisite-limited gates when their external state changes.

currentWidgetFollowup.build: v10, source Mac 38893b2, unchanged since installation
currentWidgetFollowup.currentNormalWorkspace: normal local restored; full post-Undo snapshot exact; main app closed

spokenFollowupLatest: 20 October: Human testing reproduced Settings Back button on the first focus repair, while proving whole-cache equality after actual Cancel with VoiceOver on. Native read-only lifecycle tracing then showed sheet dismissal preceding the Cancel callback in both attempts, so the first implementation never emitted a focus request. Current iOS source waits for both events in either order and consumes the request once, retaining workspace and presentation guards. The strengthened native Cancel/retry/relaunch case passes 1/0/0 with no structured runtime warnings: two accepted native callbacks, two focus events and two Restore-binding applications, plus full cache equality after each Cancel and ordinary relaunch. VoiceOver is off in that regression; a current-build spoken return is still unverified. See ios-restore-focus-order-evidence.json.
